    SUBSTR(l.name, 1, 6) AS version, c.status AS consent_status, COUNT(*) AS `count`
FROM consent c
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        broadcast.name, contact_id, MAX(created_at) latest 
    FROM broadcast
    JOIN broadcast_link link ON link.broadcast_id=broadcast.id
    JOIN source s ON s.id = link.source_id
    JOIN consent ON consent.source_id=s.id
    WHERE {{broadcast_test_id}}
    GROUP BY broadcast.id, contact_id
) l ON l.contact_id=c.contact_id AND l.latest=c.created_at
GROUP BY version, consent_status

native.query:
SELECT 
    `language`, if (actions > 50, country, 'others') as pseudo_country, sum(actions) as total_actions
FROM (
    SELECT 
      `contact`.`preferred_language` AS `language`, `contact`.`country` AS `country`, count(*) AS `actions` 
    FROM `action`
    JOIN `action_page` ON `action`.`action_page_id` = `action_page`.`id`
    JOIN `contact` ON `action`.`contact_id` = `contact`.`id`
    WHERE `action_page`.`action_type` <> 'consent' AND {{campaign_id}}
    GROUP BY `contact`.`preferred_language`, `country`
    HAVING `actions` >= 5
) tmp 
GROUP BY `language`, pseudo_country
ORDER BY `language`, pseudo_country
